hlac_sct_biophysical_spec_argon_r4.self_peptide_origin: Human importin-alpha-1 (KPNA2, UniProt P52292 residues 204-212), crystallized with HLA-C*03:04:KIR2DL2 in PDB:1EFX (Boyington et al. 2000 PMID:10850706; replaces Influenza A M1 viral peptide GILGFVFTL)
hlac_sct_biophysical_spec_argon_r4.f_pocket_exit_engineering: HLA-C*03:04 Tyr84Ala lateral F-pocket exit channel (or WT-Y84 with 25-aa L1 / Y84C-A139C disulfide trap; because native Tyr84:OH lies 3.5584 A from KIR2DL2 Asp183:OD2 with 4 atom pairs <4.5 A in PDB:1EFX [Moradi et al. 2021 PMID:33846289; AUDIT-REF], Y84A cannot inherit native K_D and requires monomeric SPR + primary KIR2DL2/3+ NK functional comparison)
hlac_sct_biophysical_spec_argon_r4.ciita_exon5_constitutive_promoter: EEF1A1_core_230 (5'TOP CAGAGA) + 154-bp SPA+MAZ4 pause terminator (transcriptional termination control at CIITA exon 5; isogenic DEXI/CLEC16A/SOCS1 expression verification required)
hlac_sct_biophysical_spec_argon_r4.mandatory_stage0_gate: Gate 0B-SCT monomeric KIR2DL2/3 SPR (K_D <= 10.29 uM), primary KIR2DL2/3+ NKG2A- NK inhibition, recipient-serum anti-HLA-C CDC/ADCC negative crossmatch (Aubert et al. 2014 PMID:24804568), and recipient CD8+ MLC non-reactivity (Whitelegg et al. 2005 PMID:16034111)
